Summer grilling is upon us! Stop & Shop has amazing summer deals on high quality meats and fresh seasonal produce. They have over 10,000 items on sale week after week!
This is one of my more popular summer recipes! To me everything tastes better on the grill and eating outside! After a long winter, summer couldn’t come fast enough my friends! 😂
INGREDIENTS
2 lbs Nature’s Promise organic free range Chicken Thighs
3 Zucchini
1 tbsp Garlic powder
1 tbsp Dried Oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
1/4 cup Extra Virgin olive oil
Sauce
1/4 cup Fresh Parsley minced
Juice of 1 Lemon
2 cloves garlic minced
1/4 cup Grated Parmigiano Reggiano
1/4 cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Salt to taste
#ad
#stopandshop #grilling #summer #bbq
